All DEPLOY tiles are integer [row,col] with explicit direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
At most eight deployed operators. Check actual DP, legal occupancy and cooldown before deployment; retreat each predecessor before replacement.
Do not credit refunds, unsupported talents, Cardigan self-healing, guaranteed splash, forced target ordering or invented navigation.
Pioneer death or missed income is a failed survival or handoff dependency. Do not continue downstream affordability assumptions or select an improvised substitute.
Manual skills require actual readiness. Skill recovery pauses while active. The frame-2865 Lava activation is absent.
Caster withdrawal requires observed patrol death. Device-clearance transitions require zero living hostiles and exhausted hostile spawns.
Officers can attack civilians within 1.2. Keep interception while hostiles remain; civilians are neither ordinary attack nor ordinary block targets.
Every conditional handoff must satisfy its gate at its declared frame; otherwise reject this fixed candidate rather than silently retime tactical actions.
WIN requires remaining_life>0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies. Acceptance additionally requires two civilian arrivals, zero civilian deaths and completion by 600 seconds.
